records.text: Candace Owens said she and her husband formally requested an interview with Vladimir Putin, the request was denied, and she had been trying to interview him for about five years.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: We then thought, hey, while we're there, we should try to see if we can get an interview with Vladimir Putin, because that would make sense. ... And so we put in a formal request and that request was denied, as it is every year. ... I've actually been trying to interview Vladimir Putin for like five years now. I actually put in a request.

verification.notes: Transcript context confirms Owens made this first-person account. Live searches found no independent record of the private interview requests, denials, or five-year timeline; the claim therefore remains attempted but unverifiable.

records.text: An unidentified embedded commentator said Vladimir Putin personally asked Candace Owens to speak at the convention.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep YeEtS7nix3o)

appearances.snippet: So the latest is Putin himself has just asked Candace Owens to speak today at this convention.

verification.notes: The embedded clip establishes that an unidentified commentator made the claim, but live searches found no authoritative program record or Putin-office confirmation that Putin personally invited Owens to speak. Attempted but unverifiable.
